cohort: 149 nulliparous women with term or prolonged pregnancy were randomly selected for this study.
finding: Vaginal isosorbide dinitrate (ISDN) significantly increased the Bishop score for cervical ripening compared to both oral ISDN and control groups, and oral ISDN also significantly increased the Bishop score compared to the control.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant difference in pregnancy termination or cesarean delivery rates among the vaginal ISDN, oral ISDN, and control groups.
